name: shopify
description: Work with Shopify products, orders, and customers using the user's own store and Admin API token. Load for catalogue/order/customer reads and creating products.

content.inline:
## Shopify
A multi-value connection: your **store** rides the base URL and the Admin API token rides its own header. Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://{s/SHOPIFY_STORE}.myshopify.com/admin/api/2024-10` with `secretHeaders: {"X-Shopify-Access-Token": "s/SHOPIFY_TOKEN"}` (a custom-app Admin API access token, `shpat_`; Settings -> Apps and sales channels -> Develop apps). The venue substitutes `{s/SHOPIFY_STORE}` and injects the header.

Common calls:
- Store: `GET /shop.json`
- Products: `GET /products.json?limit=50`
- One product: `GET /products/{id}.json`
- Orders: `GET /orders.json?status=any&limit=50`
- Customers: `GET /customers.json?limit=50`
- Create a product: `POST /products.json` body `{"product": {"title": "..."}}`

Rules:
- Check `status`; errors are `{errors}`. 401 = bad token; 403 = the app lacks that Admin API scope.
- The `store` is the part before `.myshopify.com`. Results paginate via the `Link` header `rel="next"`.
- Both the store and the token must be configured for the connection to work.
